highlights.reason_zh: 开源实现直击 RL 后训练的大模型权重刷新瓶颈，但 2.7–5.7 倍提速仍是 NVIDIA 自测。
highlights.reason_en: Public code targets a major RL post-training refit bottleneck, while the 2.7x-5.7x gains remain NVIDIA measurements.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开配置把 FLUX 3 的速度与画质取舍变成可测试工程问题，但 gated 权重与许可限制生产选择。
highlights.reason_en: Public configurations make FLUX 3 speed-quality tradeoffs testable, while gated weights and licensing constrain production choices.

highlights.reason_zh: admin key 回退与转录回显是 gateway 数据边界缺陷，直接影响共享基础设施升级判断。
highlights.reason_en: Admin-key fallback and transcript echo are gateway data-boundary defects that directly affect shared-infrastructure upgrades.

highlights.reason_zh: 策略 API 与来源字段让 Copilot review 更可治理，但多模型 ensemble 仍需人工抽检。
highlights.reason_en: Policy APIs and provenance make Copilot review more governable, while the multi-model ensemble still needs human sampling.

highlights.reason_zh: Slack／Teams GA 把对话直接接到代码变更，身份映射与误触发回滚成为上线前必测项。
highlights.reason_en: Slack/Teams GA connects conversations to code changes, making identity mapping and accidental-trigger rollback pre-deployment tests.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部读完，并完成近 30 天模型、工具、研究、开源、基础设施、政策、小团队与中外文材料补漏。NVIDIA 性能与 Copilot 效果缺独立复现；GitHub 11 月 6 日页面只有日期精度。 召回自检另补录 Arete-27B 与 P-H3-Image；两者效果均缺独立复现，后者还受地区许可限制。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were read, plus a targeted 30-day review across models, tools, research, open source, infrastructure, policy, small teams and multilingual sources. NVIDIA performance and Copilot outcomes lack independent reproduction; GitHub November 6 pages expose date-only precision. Recall audit also recovered Arete-27B and P-H3-Image; both lack independent reproduction, and the latter has territorial license limits.
